testCases.description: [API-Happy] POST creates resource, GET confirms
testCases.preconditions: API running. the system is in its default state

steps.action: POST /api/v1/resource with valid auth and body
GET the new resource by returned ID

testCases.expectedResult: Status: 200, body matches posted data

testCases.description: [API-401] Unauthorized without valid token
testCases.preconditions: API running. the system is in its default state

steps.action: GET /api/v1/resource with no Authorization header
GET /api/v1/resource with expired/invalid token

testCases.expectedResult: Status: 401, no data leaked

testCases.description: [API-Auth] Cross-user data isolation enforced
testCases.preconditions: API running. the system is in its default state

steps.action: Auth as User A, request User B's resource
Verify zero data from User B in response

testCases.expectedResult: No data leakage

testCases.description: [API-Method] PUT/DELETE are idempotent
testCases.preconditions: API running. the system is in its default state

steps.action: PUT /api/v1/resource/{id} with same body twice
DELETE /api/v1/resource/{id} twice

testCases.expectedResult: 1st: 204, 2nd: 204 or 404 (no crash)

testCases.description: [API-Security] SQL injection blocked
testCases.preconditions: API running. the system is in its default state

steps.action: POST /api/v1/resource with SQL payload
steps.expectedResult: Status: 400/422 or stored as literal string

steps.action: Verify DB integrity (no tables dropped)
